nomineeExplain.spoken: A nominee is someone the institution can receive a claim from after the holder dies. Nomination helps the process; it does not decide who legally inherits. If you have not checked, choose “Not sure”.

dateExample.spoken: Example: fourteen / zero nine / two thousand and twenty six means fourteen September two thousand and twenty six. Use the date on your record.

submissionExample.spoken: Use the day you sent the request. Example: fourteen / zero nine / two thousand and twenty six.

statementExample.spoken: A statement showing nominee names OR “Nomination: Yes”. A balance alone is not enough.

registrationExample.spoken: A bank, broker or fund letter/email confirming nomination is registered for this account. A request receipt is different.

requiredInstitution.spoken: Enter the bank, broker or fund name shown on your record.

requiredRecord.spoken: Choose the type of record you checked.

requiredCheck.spoken: Confirm that your record actually shows the nominee registered for this account.

institutionExample.spoken: For example: H D F C Bank, or the name on your statement.

nomineeNoteExample.spoken: For example: Spouse / Anu. Nickname or relationship only.

last4Example.spoken: For example: one two three four. Last four digits only.

recordNoteExample.spoken: Optional: a short note to help you find the receipt or record.

bankLocation.spoken: Use the bank name on your passbook, statement or deposit receipt.

dematLocation.spoken: Use the broker or bank on your demat statement, rather than the company whose shares you hold.

mfLocation.spoken: Use the mutual fund on your folio statement. Its registrar can help; units in demat follow the demat route.

checkLocation.spoken: Look for the nominee name or nomination status in this account’s details or latest statement.

askInstitution.spoken: If it is not shown, ask the institution: “Is nomination registered for this account? Can you confirm it in writing?”

keepUnknown.spoken: Keep “Not sure” until you can check. If the institution confirms no nominee, choose “Not added”.

submitKeep.spoken: Submit through the institution’s official channel. Keep the dated acknowledgement or receipt.

confirmRegistration.spoken: Check a statement or written confirmation that identifies this account and records the nomination. A request receipt alone does not confirm registration.

followRequest.spoken: Use the request date and receipt reference to ask the institution whether nomination was registered.

waitRegistration.spoken: Keep this as awaiting confirmation until the registration record is available.

hdfcPath.spoken: net banking: Accounts → your account → Account Details → nominee/holder details.

hdfcHolding.spoken: Sole holder: add/change there. For joint holders, the bank recommends a branch visit together.

hdfcSource.spoken: H D F C Bank instructions

homeTitle.spoken: Make your family’s accounts easier to find.

homeIntro.spoken: Check who is nominated. Take care of what is missing. Leave a clear record for your family.

typeQuestion.spoken: What kind of account is it?

dematDescription.spoken: Shares held with a broker or bank

bankDescription.spoken: Savings or a deposit with a bank

mfDescription.spoken: A folio held with a mutual fund

missingGuide.spoken: Use the institution’s nomination option or ask for its current form.

intro.spoken: Keep track of nominees. Take care of what’s missing.

emptyIntro.spoken: Demat, bank or mutual fund. Check who is nominated, one account at a time.

allClear.spoken: Keep these records up to date

extra.spoken: Add a nickname or last four digits

noIds.spoken: Use nicknames. Keep full account numbers, P A N and passwords out of this list.

registerTask.spoken: Add a nominee with your institution

confirmTask.spoken: Check that the request was registered

recordTask.spoken: Keep the confirmation with your records

dematGuide.spoken: Use the broker or bank that manages this demat account. Ask for the current nomination form or its official online option.

bankGuide.spoken: Use your bank’s branch or its official nomination facility, if available online. Ask for the current deposit nomination form.

mfGuide.spoken: Use the mutual fund or its registrar’s official service centre or online option. If the units are held in demat, use the demat account’s nomination route.

checkGuide.spoken: Check the latest statement or ask the institution. A remembered nomination may need confirmation.

receiptGuide.spoken: Keep the receipt. Then check a statement or confirmation showing the nominee was actually registered.

institutionOnly.spoken: Virasat keeps your progress. Registration happens with the institution.

sourceNote.spoken: Current form and eligibility: confirm with your institution.

confirmationCheck.spoken: The record shows the nomination is registered, not just that a request was received.

selfReport.spoken: Entered by you. Virasat has not checked institutional records.

removeAsk.spoken: Remove this account from your list?

summaryIntro.spoken: Review what your family needs to know before sharing.

summaryNotice.spoken: Includes account labels, family/nominee nicknames and last four digits if added. Record notes are omitted. Share only with someone you trust.

print.spoken: Print or save P D F

saveIntro.spoken: Download a locked file. Open it here with the same password when you return.

passwordHelp.spoken: At least twelve characters. Keep it safe; we cannot recover it.

saved.spoken: Encrypted file downloaded. Keep the password separately.

passwordShort.spoken: Use a password of twelve to two hundred and fifty six characters.

cannotUnlock.spoken: The password or encrypted file could not be verified.

invalidSave.spoken: This saved list is invalid or too large.

invalidAccount.spoken: Enter the institution name. Use exactly four digits if adding a reference.

invalidDate.spoken: Use a real date, no later than today. Confirmation cannot be before submission.

submissionRequired.spoken: Add the date you submitted the request.

confirmationRequired.spoken: Add the record type and date, then confirm it shows registration. A receipt alone is not enough.

accountLimit.spoken: This list can hold up to fifty accounts.

privacyDetail.spoken: Your list stays in browser memory. Reloading clears it. Save an encrypted file to return later. Downloads remain on your device.

translationNotice.spoken: Draft translations; fluent-reader review is pending. Official forms keep their original language.

boundary.spoken: This list does not determine inheritance rights, discover accounts or submit requests.

clearAsk.spoken: Clear the list from this session? Saved downloads will remain.

speechUnavailable.spoken: This instruction’s audio is not ready. The written instructions are still here.

optoutNote.spoken: Not added may reflect a deliberate opt-out. Check the record and choose with the account holder.

startHelp.spoken: Start with a passbook, statement or the app you already use. One account is enough to begin.

howWorksText.spoken: We help you check the right place, prepare your next step, and keep the result. Your bank, broker or fund makes the actual change.

searchDemat.spoken: Search for your broker or bank

searchHelp.spoken: Type a name or abbreviation. You can also enter an institution that is not listed.

noMatches.spoken: No matches. Check the spelling, or keep the name you entered.

contextHelp.spoken: These details help us show the right instructions. It is fine to be unsure.

holderQuestion.spoken: Is the account held alone or jointly?

mfMode.spoken: How are these mutual funds held?

folioMode.spoken: A folio with the mutual fund

identifyText.spoken: A fund statement usually shows a folio number and fund name. A demat statement shows a D P I D / Client I D or B O I D. If unsure, ask the provider how the units are held.

prepareIntro.spoken: Have these ready for the institution. You do not need to enter them here.

prepareNames.spoken: The nominee’s name and relationship, as shown in their records.

prepareMinor.spoken: If a nominee is a child, check the date-of-birth and guardian sections on the current form.

prepareAccess.spoken: Your own account reference and access to the institution’s official service. Keep passwords and OTPs there only.

jointGuide.spoken: For a joint account, involve every holder. Ask the institution which signatures and channel are required before submitting.

unknownContext.spoken: Check the holder names and account type on your statement before choosing an online route. The institution can help identify them.

hdfcSavings.spoken: In H D F C net banking, open Accounts → select the account → Account Details → Nominee and Account Holder details.

hdfcDeposit.spoken: In H D F C net banking, open F D/R D → select the deposit → look for Add Nominee or Change Nominee. Check this deposit separately from your savings account.

hdfcAction.spoken: Sole holders can use Add Nominee or Change Nominee in the relevant account details. For joint holdings, use the bank’s branch route with the other holders.

zerodhaCheck.spoken: Open Zerodha Console → Account → Nominees. This nomination also covers mutual funds held in that demat account, including Coin.

zerodhaAction.spoken: Use the nomination instructions in Console. Zerodha directs joint holders and people without an Aadhaar-linked mobile to its offline form. Check current requirements on the linked help page.

hdfcMfGuide.spoken: Use H D F C Mutual Fund’s nominee-registration service page for the current request form and submission instructions. Match the folio on your statement before starting.

mfDematHelp.spoken: These units use the nomination on the demat account. Check that account with your broker or D P; do not assume a separate folio nomination is needed.

routeFallback.spoken: We have general guidance for this institution. Confirm the exact screen or form with its official service team.

offlineText.spoken: Take your account or folio reference to the branch or official service centre. Ask for nomination registration or a change, and a dated acknowledgement. Ask which holders must attend before travelling.

askText.spoken: Please check whether nomination is registered for this account. If it is missing or needs changing, which current form or official online option should I use? Please confirm the result in writing.

followupHelp.spoken: This is your own reminder date, not an institution’s deadline. Download it to your calendar if you want an alert.

blockedHelp.spoken: Keep the institution’s response. Ask what is missing, which correction is needed, and how to resubmit. A rejected or incomplete request is not a registered nomination.

familyHelp.spoken: Add only what will help your family recognise the account and find its records. You can leave private details out.

recordLocation.spoken: Where can your family find the record? (optional)

locationHelp.spoken: For example: Blue folder at home. This location is included in the family sheet. Do not add passwords or full account numbers.

saveTip.spoken: After downloading, look in Downloads for your .virasat file. Keep the password separately. New changes need a new save.

detailsChecked.spoken: I also checked the nominee details

receiptExample.spoken: “Your request has been received” means the request is pending.

registeredExample.spoken: “Nomination registered” or “Nomination: Yes” records registration. Check it identifies this account.

voicePreview.spoken: I will read the instructions in your language, one step at a time.

voiceHelp.spoken: Audio is included in all six languages. No voice installation is needed. Only the written instructions are played; your entries and passwords stay private.

speechError.spoken: Audio could not load. Check your connection, then tap Try again. Your place is kept.

languageHelp.spoken: Change language at any time. Your work stays in place.

optoutHelp.spoken: This records the holder’s choice in this list only. Any formal opt-out must be completed with the institution. The choice can be reviewed later.

chooseType.spoken: Choose an account type to continue.

shareHelp.spoken: Choose what to include, then review the sheet below. The downloaded copy is not password-protected.

helpScopeText.spoken: This journey is for a living holder arranging nomination. If the holder has died, ask the institution for its deceased-holder claim or transmission process. Do not start a new nomination on their behalf.

openDevice.spoken: Open the locked copy on this device

keepDevice.spoken: Also keep a locked copy on this device

deviceHelp.spoken: Optional: keep a password-protected copy in this browser. You must save again after changes. On a shared device, leave this off. We never store your password.

forgetDevice.spoken: Remove the saved copy from this device

forgetDeviceAsk.spoken: Remove this device’s locked copy? Downloaded files will remain.

deviceUnavailable.spoken: The file was downloaded, but this browser could not keep a device copy. Use the downloaded file to return.

chooseFile.spoken: Choose your saved .virasat file or the device copy.

replaceDraft.spoken: Start another account? Your unfinished account will be replaced.

replaceList.spoken: Opening another list will replace this session. Save your work first if you need it.

validFollowup.spoken: Enter a real date, or leave all three boxes empty.

privateRecordHelp.spoken: This note is kept in your locked save, and left out of the family summary and page audio.

connectionHelp.spoken: Use the demat statement to check that these fund units are held in this exact demat account, with the same holders. Accounts belonging to different family members do not share a nomination.

sameHolders.spoken: I checked the statement: these units and holders match this demat account.

replaceChanges.spoken: You have unfinished changes. Continuing replaces that draft. Cancel to return Home and finish or save it first.

startOwnHelp.spoken: Start a fresh list for your family? This removes the fictional example from this session.

familyReviewCheck.spoken: I reviewed what my family should see. I chose to leave any blank fields out.

familyReviewHelp.spoken: This is a separate check. A registered nomination does not tell your family where to find the account or its records.

familyReadyNext.spoken: Keep this sheet somewhere your trusted family member can find it. Review it when details change.

routeChoice.spoken: How would you like to do this?

saveBeforeLeaving.spoken: Save your place before opening the official service. Come back here to record what happened.

offlineContact.spoken: Use the institution's official help page to locate a branch or service centre. Ask whether it handles nomination for this account before travelling.

offlineBring.spoken: Ask which form, holder signatures and documents are needed. Take a statement or passbook to identify the account; keep originals with you unless the institution requires them.

offlineAsk.spoken: Ask staff to check the existing nomination first. If a change is needed, ask for a dated receipt and how to obtain the final registration record.

scopeGeneral.spoken: General guidance for this account type. We have not reviewed this institution's exact screens.

scopeHdfc.spoken: H D F C Bank: savings and F D/R D guidance; joint holders use the branch route.

scopeSbi.spoken: S B I deposit accounts. This guide covers available channels; it does not claim a tested login sequence.

scopeAxis.spoken: Axis Bank savings accounts only. F D/R D routes may differ.

scopeZerodhaAdd.spoken: Zerodha: first nominee addition. Joint accounts or unavailable Aadhaar-linked mobile access need institution assistance.

scopeZerodhaChange.spoken: Zerodha: changing existing nominee details or adding another nominee.

scopeGroww.spoken: Groww demat account. Existing mutual-fund folios can require a separate service route.

scopeHdfcMf.spoken: H D F C Mutual Fund folios. Demat-held units follow the demat account's nomination.

scopeDematFunds.spoken: First identify and check the demat account holding these units.

scopeUnknownFunds.spoken: The holding format must be identified before choosing a nomination route.

sbiAction.spoken: S B I offers deposit-account nomination through YONO, Internet Banking and branches. Choose the specific account. If the option you need is unavailable, ask a branch to register or change it using the current form.

axisStart.spoken: In Axis Internet Banking, open Services → Account Services → Update Nominee. Select the savings account, then Add New Nominee or Change Nominee.

axisSubmit.spoken: Axis's help page describes generating a request form, completing and signing it, uploading it, and confirming with the net secure code. If you cannot print or upload, use a branch.

zerodhaChangeForms.spoken: Open Zerodha's change instructions. Get the current nomination and account-modification forms; enter the existing and proposed nominee details as directed.

zerodhaChangeSubmit.spoken: Zerodha describes signing both forms by hand, e signing them, and attaching them to a support ticket. Follow the current instructions; ask support for an alternative if you cannot e sign.

growwCheck.spoken: In Groww, open Profile → Account Details → Nominee Details. Check which investment or account the displayed nomination applies to.

growwAction.spoken: Use Edit Nominee for eligible demat investments and follow Groww's verification. Updating the profile does not establish that every existing mutual-fund folio changed; check those folios separately.

readingPreferences.spoken: Reading settings are remembered on this device. Account details are saved only when you choose Save. Reset clears these reading preferences.

savedNext.spoken: Your locked copy is ready. Keep the file and password somewhere you can find again. Return to your task when you are ready.

olderDeviceCopy.spoken: The device copy was not updated. Open the downloaded file for your latest changes, or save again with the device option selected.

audioBlocked.spoken: Tap Continue listening to play the next part.

audioData.spoken: Audio loads only when you listen. Recently played instructions can work offline on supported browsers. First-time listening needs internet.

audioDraft.spoken: These are computer-generated voices. Pronunciation is still being reviewed. Follow the written instructions if you hear a difference.

audioCleared.spoken: Saved audio removed. Your account list is unchanged.

audioPrivacy.spoken: Only public instructions are saved for listening again. Audio requests use this website; no entries are sent to a voice service. Hosting logs can include your IP address and requested audio files.
